workflow.journal.takeover: Taken over from {previousOwnerName}. Scenario progress kept ({filledSteps}/{totalSteps})
workflow.journal.escalation_ceiling: Nobody to escalate to: reaction deadline breached, alert sent
workflow.journal.resolution_ceiling: Resolution deadline breached, nobody to escalate to: alert sent
workflow.journal.system_hold_break: Put on hold by the system: {holdReasonLabel}
workflow.journal.system_hold_idle: Put on hold by the system: no connection with the operator
workflow.journal.system_release_idle: Returned to the queue: the operator is not responding
workflow.journal.addressee_signed_out_to: The addressee signed out without accepting: transferred to group {targetName}

workflow.journal.owner_signed_out: Returned to the queue: the operator signed out

workflow.journal.addressee_cannot_accept: Returned to the queue: {previousOwnerName} cannot accept
workflow.journal.alert_no_recipient: Alert not sent: no available recipient has access to the object
workflow.guard.not_owner: You are not the incident owner
workflow.guard.not_target: The handoff is addressed to someone else
workflow.guard.is_target: The handoff is addressed to you
workflow.guard.target_cannot_accept: The addressee cannot accept: no «Accept» right or no access to the object
workflow.guard.target_no_access: The addressee has no access to the incident object
workflow.guard.agent_state: Operator state does not allow this
workflow.guard.addressee_access: The addressee's access does not match
workflow.guard.addressee_can_accept: Whether the addressee can accept does not match
workflow.guard.owner_duty_group: The owner's duty group does not match
workflow.guard.active_limit: Active limit ({n}). First close or hold {id}
workflow.guard.hold_limit: You cannot hold more than {n} incidents
workflow.guard.required_steps: Fill in the mandatory closing steps
workflow.guard.wrong_state: Not available in the current state
workflow.guard.no_read_done: No permission to open other operators’ cards
workflow.guard.setting_other: The setting has a different value
workflow.error.reason_required: Give a reason — the field is mandatory
workflow.transition.merge.hint: Take the ticked into work as one: the primary is yours, the others become its linked incidents
workflow.transition.linked_lost_access: Detached: the primary's addressee has no access to the object
workflow.transition.detach.hint: Return the incident to the queue as new
workflow.journal.linked_lost_access: Detached from {primaryNumber} and returned to the queue: the primary's addressee has no access to the object
workflow.journal.linked_lost_access_prim: {number} detached and returned to the queue: the addressee has no access to its object
workflow.journal.reopen_unlinked: Reopened separately from {primaryNumber}: no longer linked
workflow.journal.linked_reopened: {number} reopened separately and is no longer linked
workflow.guard.merge_primary: You can merge into an open incident that is new or yours in progress
workflow.guard.primary_not_editable: Only whoever handles the primary incident can detach
workflow.guard.primary_open: The primary incident is still open
workflow.guard.primary_addressee_access: The primary addressee's access does not match
workflow.guard.target_no_access_linked: The addressee has no access to the objects of the linked incidents: detach them or transfer separately
workflow.error.merge.scenarios: Scenarios differ: {titles}. Only incidents of one scenario are taken as one
workflow.guard.merge_scenario: The scenario differs from the primary's: only incidents of one scenario are taken as one
workflow.error.precondition_required: No record version: request without If-Match
workflow.error.selection_unavailable: This action is not available for the current selection
workflow.error.break_no_permission: No permission to go on a break
workflow.error.selection_too_large: The selection has more than {n, plural, one {# incident} other {# incidents}} — a group action does not take that many
workflow.error.read_only: The card is open for viewing only
workflow.error.previous_steps: Fill in the previous steps first
workflow.error.no_schema_admin: No permission to configure the schema
workflow.catalog.mass_fault.known: Known fault, work is in progress
workflow.form.transfer.title: Transfer the incident
workflow.form.transfer.note.0: The incident is transferred without being taken. The level will become {nextEscalationLevel}.
workflow.form.transfer.note.1: The incident is taken by {ownerName}. Transfer to another recipient without taking over.
workflow.form.transfer.note.2: Handling stops, scenario progress goes to the recipient. The level will become {nextEscalationLevel}.
workflow.form.hold.title: Put the incident on hold
workflow.form.hold.note.0: The resolution timer pauses and continues when you resume.
workflow.form.release.title: Return to queue
workflow.form.release.note.0: The incident becomes unassigned, the response timer restarts, the resolution timer pauses. Scenario progress is kept.
workflow.form.reject.title: Reject the handoff
workflow.form.reject.note.0: The incident goes back to the common queue; the escalation level is kept.
workflow.form.reject.field.comment.place: Why you are not accepting it
workflow.form.close.title: Closing the incident
workflow.form.close.note.1: Scenario filled in: {filledSteps} of {totalSteps}. The outcome will be sent to AxxonData.
workflow.form.reopen.title: Reopen the incident
workflow.form.reopen.note.0: Finished {minutesSinceClose} min ago. The resolution timer starts again; earlier breaches stay recorded.
workflow.form.reopen.field.comment.place: Why it must go back into work
workflow.form.takeover.title: Take over the incident
workflow.form.takeover.note.0: The incident is taken by {ownerName}. Scenario progress {filledSteps}/{totalSteps} is kept, their card switches to view-only.
workflow.transition.accept.hint: Accept the handoff addressed to you
workflow.transition.reject.hint: Send the handoff back to the common queue
workflow.transition.hold.hint: Put on hold with a reason
workflow.transition.resume.hint: Continue handling with the same remaining time
workflow.transition.release.hint: Drop the incident and return it to the common queue
workflow.transition.transfer.hint: Hand the incident to another recipient
workflow.transition.takeover.hint: Take the incident from the operator working on it
workflow.transition.reopen.hint: Bring a finished incident back into work
workflow.transition.resolution_ceiling: Resolution deadline breached, nobody to escalate to
workflow.transition.system_hold_idle: On hold: no connection with the operator
workflow.transition.system_release_idle: Returned to the queue: the operator is not responding
workflow.transition.addressee_signed_out: Addressee signed out: passed to their duty group
Addressee signed out: returned to the queue
workflow.transition.owner_signed_out: Operator signed out: returned to the queue
workflow.transition.addressee_lost_acces: Returned to the queue: the owner or addressee has no access to the object
workflow.transition.addressee_cannot_acc: Returned to the queue: the addressee cannot accept
workflow.nav.open_done.hint: Open the card of a finished incident
workflow.session.readonly.not_ready: On a break only viewing is available
workflow.session.readonly.offline: You have signed out of IM: only viewing is available
workflow.schema.name: Operator incident handling
workflow.permission.incident.claim: Take a new incident, resume your own on-hold one; take over and reopen — together with their own rights. Without it an incident cannot get into work
workflow.permission.incident.accept: Accept a handoff addressed to me or my duty group
workflow.permission.incident.hold: Put your own incident on hold with a reason
workflow.permission.incident.release: Return your own incident to the queue; reject an addressed handoff
workflow.permission.incident.close: Close your own incident with a result: «Processed» — after the required steps; «False alarm», «Duplicate», «Scheduled check», «Aborted» — without the scenario
workflow.permission.incident.close.unpro: Close with the «Mass failure» result without the scenario, including without taking into work
workflow.permission.incident.reopen: Bring a closed incident back into work
workflow.permission.incident.transfer.ow: Transfer your own, unassigned or addressed-to-me incident
workflow.permission.incident.transfer.an: Transfer an incident held by another operator
workflow.permission.incident.reassign: Take over an incident from a working operator
workflow.permission.incident.read.any: Open another operator's incident card read-only
workflow.permission.incident.run_action: Run macros and commands from the card
workflow.permission.incident.schema.admi: Change the schema, targets and auto-escalation settings
workflow.settings.timers.reaction.defaul: How long to wait for pick-up unless set more precisely
workflow.settings.timers.reaction.overri: Reaction deadline by event type, priority and device group; the most specific row wins
workflow.settings.timers.resolution.defa: How long an incident may be worked from first pick-up to closing
workflow.settings.timers.resolution.over: Resolution deadline by event type, priority and device group
workflow.settings.limits.reopenWindowMin: How long after closing an incident can be reopened (§6.1)
workflow.settings.limits.reopenResolutio: Resolution deadline of a reopened incident; empty — the usual one (§4, rule 6)
workflow.settings.reasonCatalogs.hold.it: What the operator chooses on “Put on hold” and the time limit of each reason; system ones are break and no connection
workflow.settings.reasonCatalogs.mass_fa: What is chosen when closing as “Mass failure”
workflow.settings.session.breakReasons.w: What the operator chooses when going on a break
workflow.settings.escalation.enabled.wha: Whether an incident not picked up in time is passed up the levels; off — only a breach and an alert
workflow.settings.escalation.levels.what: Addressee of each level — a user or a duty group — and its reaction deadline
workflow.settings.escalation.maxLevel.wh: The incident is not passed above this level
workflow.settings.escalation.onResolutio: What to do when the resolution deadline expires
Breach, alert and passing to the next level
workflow.settings.escalation.reasonKey.w: Text of the auto-escalation log entry
workflow.settings.alerts.target.what: A user or a duty group; received by those available and with access to the object
Log entry when there is nobody to send the alert to
workflow.settings.limits.maxActive.what: How many incidents an operator can work at once; an incident with its linked ones counts as one. Can be «unlimited»: then an operator takes as many as they like and nobody else gets them — lift it only if the post works several incidents in parallel
workflow.settings.limits.maxOnHold.what: How many the operator can put on hold manually. Can be «unlimited»: manual «Hold» is always available
workflow.settings.limits.maxBulk.what: How many incidents can be selected for a group action. Can be «unlimited»: one group action goes to all selected at once
workflow.settings.session.heartbeatSec.w: How often the workstation reports that the operator is connected
workflow.settings.session.idleHoldSec.wh: After how much silence the operator's incident goes to “On hold — no connection”
workflow.settings.session.idleReleaseSec: After how much silence an incident held for a system reason returns to the queue
workflow.settings.queueSort.default.what: Which incident the operator sees first
workflow.settings.queueSort.default.valu: By time left before the reaction target is breached
workflow.settings.queueSort.operatorMayC: Choose a different order from the list
workflow.settings.tab.priorities.what: Urgency levels: a number from 0 to 100 (higher is more urgent), name, description and queue stripe color. An IM reference shared by all schemas
workflow.settings.tab.access_groups.what: Which device groups and devices are available to which roles: an operator sees only incidents of available objects
workflow.settings.tab.duty_groups.what: Who an incident can be addressed to instead of one person: name, roles, individual people; the order of groups is the priority
workflow.settings.tab.source_groups.what: Device group tree: access groups and queue filters are built on it
workflow.settings.tab.links.what: Help menu: regulations, phones, plans, emergency contacts — common and site links
workflow.settings.tab.camera_links.what: Links between devices and cameras: which cameras to show and in what order; an incident shows the cameras of all links of its source, the first is the main one
workflow.error.test.bad_incident: A known event type, a priority from the catalog and at least one device are required
workflow.notice.system_hold_idle: No link to {previousOwner} — the system put {id} on hold
workflow.journal.timer_overridden: Target «{timer}» expired — the operator acted before «{transition}»
workflow.settings.invariants.manualWinsO: How long after a deadline to wait for the operator before the timer transition fires; an action in this window wins (§10.1)
